groups.title: Server groups
groups.description: Groups decide which nodes a user can use; buying a plan grants the plan's group.
groups.name: Name
groups.deleteHint: Groups still used by users, plans or nodes cannot be deleted.

routes.title: Routes
routes.description: Routes sent to XrayR / V2bX; “Block” rules are also soga audit rules.
routes.deleteHint: Routes still referenced by nodes cannot be deleted; remove them from the nodes first.
routes.actionHint: Block: matching connections are refused. DNS: matching domains resolve through the given server.
routes.matchHintBlock: One per line, up to {max}. All lines joined with | must form a valid Go regexp (XrayR crashes on an invalid one); soga also understands domain:, full:, regexp:, geosite:, ip: prefixes.
routes.matchHintDns: One domain per line, up to {max}.

errors.required: Add at least one match rule

nodes.title: Nodes
nodes.description: Status refreshes every minute; green means traffic reports, orange means heartbeats only.
nodes.deleteHint: Backends can no longer pull this node's configuration.
nodes.deleteChildren: This node has {count} child nodes. Make sure they point to another parent first.
nodes.sortDisabled: Reordering is disabled while filters are active.
nodes.fixProtocol: Please fix the errors in the protocol settings.

stats.title: Traffic of “{name}”
stats.childHint: Child node traffic is counted on the parent.

online.title: Online users on “{name}”
online.hint: Users with traffic or a reported IP in the last two report intervals. IPs come from V2bX alive / soga alive_ip; XrayR doesn't report them.

fields.name: Name
fields.tagsHint: Comma separated; shown in subscription node names
fields.hostHint: Domain or IP sent to clients
fields.portHint: Port clients connect to; Hysteria port hopping takes a range such as 20000-30000
fields.groupsHint: Users in these groups can use this node; with none selected nobody can
fields.routesHint: Route / audit rules sent to the backend
fields.parentHint: Child nodes are relay entrances: they reuse the parent's protocol settings and credentials, and traffic counts on the parent. Only standalone nodes of the same protocol can be parents.
fields.showHint: Hidden nodes stay out of subscriptions but backends can still pull them

errors.port: Use 1–65535 or an ascending range such as 20000-30000
errors.serverPort: Server port must be an integer from 1 to 65535

json.label: protocol_settings (JSON)
json.hint: Edit the protocol settings directly. Every valid JSON object applies immediately; keys the form does not cover are kept.
json.invalid: Invalid JSON or not an object; not applied.

integration.intro: Configure the backend with the snippet below. The shared secret (server_token) is in
integration.unsaved: The node ID exists after saving; save first, then copy the snippet.
integration.child: Child node: the backend may use the child's or the parent's ID; the panel answers with the parent's configuration either way.
integration.unsupported: This backend does not support the protocol.
integration.xrayrHint: XrayR ignores the panel's intervals: set UpdatePeriodic to at most the panel's push interval. With no eligible users XrayR logs an error and keeps the previous user list.
integration.v2bxHint: V2bX uses the panel's pull/push intervals and enforces device limits through alivelist.
integration.sogaHint: Use the /soga/ prefix for webapi_url; the soga licence binds to the full webapi_url.

ps.xhttpExtraHint: Advanced XHTTP options, passed through as is
ps.networkJsonHint: Advanced: edit the transport settings (xray format) directly for keys the form does not cover
ps.tlsLocalCert: The backend terminates TLS with its local certificate
ps.allowInsecureHint: Only affects the subscription sent to clients
ps.keysUnsupported: This browser has no X25519; run xray x25519 on a server to create keys
ps.shortIdHint: 0–16 hex characters, even length; may be empty
ps.decryptionHint: Server-side VLESS encryption, e.g. mlkem768x25519plus.native.600s.<private key>; empty disables it
ps.serverKeyHint: {bytes}-byte base64 key; empty derives one from the node's creation time
ps.pluginHint: SIP003 plugin name sent to clients
ps.ssrPasswordHint: For single-port mode; empty derives one
ps.singlePortHint: How soga tells users apart on one port
ps.trojanTls: Trojan always uses TLS; the backend provides the certificate.
ps.hopIntervalHint: Used by clients when the client port is a range
ps.serverNamesHint: Comma separated; empty uses the SNI
ps.paddingHint: One entry per line; empty uses the default scheme

compat.v2bxHttp: V2bX (xray core) does not support HTTP / HTTP/2 transports.
compat.sogaHttpUpgrade: soga has no HTTPUpgrade transport; the setting is passed through and may not work.
compat.ssChacha2022: 2022-blake3-chacha20-poly1305 is unreliable for multiple users on V2bX's sing core; prefer an AES cipher.
compat.sogaHysteria1: soga runs Hysteria 2 only; this node cannot be served by soga.
compat.anytlsRealitySogaOnly: V2bX's AnyTLS has no REALITY; only soga can serve this.
compat.tuicV2bxOnly: TUIC is supported by V2bX only (not XrayR or soga).
compat.mieruSogaOnly: Mieru is supported by soga only (not XrayR or V2bX).

validation.invalidJson: Invalid JSON or not an object; not applied
